name: siden-plus
description: Annotate Markdown and PDF text with highlights, margin notes, and a review sidebar.
author: Giuseppe

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.deploy: npm run build && mkdir -p "$HOME/Documents/obsidian-notes/mynotes/.obsidian/plugins/siden-plus" && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css "$HOME/Documents/obsidian-notes/mynotes/.obsidian/plugins/siden-plus/"
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
